'Choose 1: The next attack action card with cost 1 or less you play this turn gains +2{p} / ... gains go again.' + printed Go again.

REWRITTEN FROM AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THIS SAME FILE: the previous version queued on the ATTACK queue (MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK / GRANT_NEXT_ATTACK_KEYWORD), which is consumed when an attack is MADE. The printed text names 'the next attack action card ... you PLAY this turn', and this batch's triage primitives name the card-play vocabulary (MODIFY_NEXT_CARD / CARD_COST_LTE / CARD_IS_ATTACK), so this version now mirrors .drafts/captains_call_blue.json slug-for-slug except the threshold (cost <= 1 here, 0 there). Deviation from red/yellow siblings disclosed: captains_call_red.json still carries the old attack-queue shape; if this rewrite is adopted, red should follow.

PRINTED GO AGAIN IS NOT AUTHORED: printed_keywords carries GoAgain - the card's own unconditional 'Go again' line fires from the card DB keywords field, and re-authoring it as an effect would be a defect (it is also why there are only TWO modes here, not three).

MODE TIMING: release note 1 ('you choose the mode at the time you play Captain's Call') is exactly MODAL choose 1 - modes are selected when the card is put on the stack (CR 1.7.5a).

WHY THE CARD-PLAY QUEUE: GRANT_NEXT_CARD queues a one-shot entry on the controller's dsl_queued_card_mods (effect_types.py:4665+, reads amount/filter/on_consume/keyword(s)/uses/grant_abilities), consumed by the first matching PLAYED card (play.py:1713-1747); amount 0 correctly means no cost delta, only the grant (verified precedent: shipped pen/fasting_carcass_blue.json for the go-again half). MODE A (+2{p}) uses grant_abilities, NOT on_consume MODIFY_ATTACK: on_consume runs at PLAY time where MODIFY_ATTACK returns early outside combat (effect_types.py:4127); instead the entry attaches a TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK ability to the consuming copy (play.py:1739-1742 stores raw dicts on card.granted_abilities), so the pump lands when that card enters the combat chain and combat exists.

FILTER PARAMS VERIFIED AGAINST HANDLERS: CARD_IS_ATTACK reads 'value' and tests the candidate's is_attack (condition_types.py:1451+); CARD_IS_TYPE unions types and subtypes and reads 'card_type' (1309+); CARD_COST_LTE reads 'amount' (or 'cost') against the played card's own cost (1219+). Together they name precisely 'attack action card with cost 1 or less'.

RELEASE NOTE 2 IS THE QUEUE'S OWN BEHAVIOUR: _cost_mod_matches (play.py:625-643) compiles the filter against each card as it is played; non-matching cards leave the entry queued - 'if you play an attack action that doesn't meet that criteria, then one that does, the bonus will still apply to the one applicable'. Unused entries are cleared at end of turn (engine.py:933-934), so 'this turn' holds without extra fields.

No known gaps; every clause is expressible.
